hotspot_events.title: Nvidia's seventh straight decline as SEC accounting probe and California investigation break: closed Nov 20 at $125.53 (-14.01%)
hotspot_events.heat_reason: The SEC accounting probe (Reuters exclusive) plus a California attorney general investigation and the board's refusal to reinstate Jensen Huang — a triple blow: -14.01% in one day, a seventh straight decline, about -43% in November. The wobbling AI narrative directly hits liquid-cooling CDU order sentiment
hotspot_events.summary: Nvidia closed Nov 20 at $125.53 (-14.01%), a seventh consecutive down day, about -24.5% over five days, about -43% for November and about -47.5% from its Oct 6 high, with roughly $2.7 trillion in market value wiped out. Reuters reported exclusively on Nov 20 that SEC enforcement staff are reviewing potential accounting issues (the SEC declined to comment and Nvidia did not respond; an investigation is not a finding of wrongdoing). California's attorney general opened an investigation on Nov 21 into chip transfers and misleading investors. Trump said on Nov 21 he hopes Jensen Huang returns. Huang has agreed to testify publicly before the Senate and will meet privately with three House committees on Dec 1. The stock rebounded somewhat after hours.
numbers: Roughly $2.7 trillion in market value wiped out

hotspot_events.title: Copper falls sharply for a second day while spot stays tight: SHFE main contract closed Nov 20 at CNY 92,400/t
hotspot_events.heat_reason: SHFE copper fell 5.07% then 3.35% over two days, and LME copper is about 14% below its October record high — yet SHFE inventories are at a three-year low and the import premium is at a record high: paper prices down, physical market still tight
hotspot_events.summary: The SHFE main copper contract fell 5.07% on Nov 19 to CNY 94,720/t and another 3.35% on Nov 20 to CNY 92,400/t. LME copper was quoted at $12,022.45/t on Nov 20 (-4.02%, Mysteel basis), about 14% below its Oct 28 record high. But SHFE inventories stand at 27,640 tons (the lowest since December 2023) and China's refined-copper import premium is at a record $360/t, with spot premiums still high.
numbers: SHFE copper Nov 19: -5.07%, closed at CNY 94,720/t
SHFE copper Nov 20: -3.35%, closed at CNY 92,400/t

hotspot_events.title: Ga/Ge/Sb suspension expires Nov 27 — five days left, still no extension notice
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Announcement No. 72's suspension runs to Nov 27, and as of this morning there is still no extension notice. Once it lapses, export licences for Ga/Ge/Sb to the US will in principle not be approved, affecting GaN power devices and antimony-based flame retardants
hotspot_events.summary: Announcement No. 72's suspension runs to Nov 27, 2026, and as of the morning of Nov 22 no extension notice has appeared. Announcement No. 58, issued Nov 9, only extended the October package of measures to Jan 10, 2027 and does not cover Announcement No. 72. Once the suspension lapses, export licences for gallium, germanium and antimony to the US will in principle not be approved.

sources.outlet: Ministry of Commerce announcement (Announcement No. 58, original text)

industry_updates.title: Midea cuts R290 air-conditioner charge by 40%, with over 10 million units sold globally
industry_updates.detail: Midea optimized its system architecture and refrigerant management to cut the R290 air-conditioner charge by 40%, driven mainly by GMCC's advanced twin-cylinder permanent-magnet inverter rotary compressor. Over 10 million R290 air conditioners have been sold worldwide, avoiding about 5.2 million tons of CO₂-equivalent emissions (Midea's figure).

industry_updates.title: Carrier launches ClimaVision 3-MyStat Pro Pack, bringing 75F technology into its HVAC line
industry_updates.detail: Carrier launched the ClimaVision 3-MyStat Pro Pack on Nov 17, bringing the controls, cloud and AI technology acquired with 75F into more HVAC products. Orders open this year, with shipments starting in early 2027.

industry_updates.title: Vertiv unveils 800 VDC architecture expansion and ATLAS lab at SC26
industry_updates.detail: Vertiv unveiled an 800 VDC architecture expansion: the PowerDirect 9000 (1.5 MW) and PowerNexus MV SST (5 MW solid-state transformer), covering three tiers from rack to compute hall to data hall. The same day it announced the ATLAS lab in collaboration with Nvidia.

industry_updates.title: Shenling wins Shunde industrial land for CNY 235 million, plans CNY 2 billion liquid-cooling smart-manufacturing base
industry_updates.detail: Shenling won 260.97 mu of industrial land in Chencun, Shunde for CNY 234.88 million on Nov 16, with a planned total investment of at least CNY 2 billion to build a global R&D center and a new-generation liquid-cooling AI-computing infrastructure smart-manufacturing base.
industry_updates.source: Foshan News (citing Shenling's board resolution announcement), Nov 18, 2026

industry_updates.title: Daikin Europe launches Vertical Water and Space Cooler & Heater ranges
industry_updates.detail: Daikin Europe launched the Daikin Vertical Water and Space Cooler & Heater ranges on Nov 16 (DX and water-system versions), aimed at large spaces in warehousing, logistics and manufacturing, available from November.

industry_updates.title: US BIS remote-access rule takes effect Nov 19
industry_updates.detail: The US Commerce Department's BIS remote-access rule took effect on Nov 19, imposing new controls on exports of advanced semiconductors to overseas data centers. China's Ministry of Commerce said the same day it strongly objects and that China will take countermeasures if the US insists on going ahead (countermeasures not yet decided).

siphon_effects.detail: Nvidia's FY2027 Q3 revenue was $115.8 billion (+103% year on year), data-center revenue $107.6 billion (+110% year on year), and Q4 guidance $130 billion (±3%). The Vera Rubin NVL72 has shipped and set the fastest ramp on record. But the SEC accounting probe triggered a seven-day slide, casting doubt on the AI investment narrative, with copper prices falling in tandem — the siphon is shifting from across-the-board price rises to diverging demand.
siphon_effects.source: Nvidia official site, Nov 17, 2026; Motley Fool, Nov 20, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: TrendForce's Nov 11 update: Q4 PC DRAM contract prices up 13%-18% quarter on quarter, enterprise SSDs up 15%-20%. SanDisk raised November NAND contract prices by about 50% (its third increase this year), and module maker Transcend suspended quoting and deliveries from Nov 7. Spot prices diverge: 512Gb TLC wafer spot is about $15, down about 20% in two weeks. Lenovo says memory supply is constraining AI server deliveries.
siphon_effects.source: TrendForce via CtrlTechDaily; Xintong News, Nov 11, 2026; Science and Technology Daily, Nov 20, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: Samsung Electro-Mechanics' Q4 consumer X5R quotes are up 25%-30% and AI-grade X6S up 10%-20% (TrendForce estimate). Q3 MLCC average prices rose 21.4% year on year, and long-term supply-contract prepayments exceeded KRW 1 trillion at end-Q3 (+43.9% quarter on quarter). Lead times are 40 weeks.
siphon_effects.source: MoneyToday, Nov 18, 2026; XMY citing Guotai Junan Securities, Nov 11, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: Rubin rack thermal design power reaches up to 227 kW (Lenovo MaxP) / 240 kW (Gigabyte). Nidec said on Nov 20 that customers are shifting from in-rack CDUs to in-row CDUs (about 250 kW per unit, stackable to 1-1.25 MW). The value of heat-dissipation components per Rubin rack (excluding the CDU) is about 37% higher than for GB300 (J.P. Morgan estimate).

Shengyi's November price increases have landed (M6 and below laminates +15%, prepreg PP +25%), and Kingboard has raised prices for the eighth time this year. High-performance CCL procurement runs 24-32 weeks, with 106/1080/2116 glass-fiber cloth in short supply and several suppliers on allocation.
siphon_effects.source: Pengcheng Business News citing China Securities Journal, Nov 10, 2026; VersaLogic, Nov 4, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: LATO interviewed 29 practitioners between Nov 13 and 17: grid connection was the most-cited cause of delays, and large transformers take more than two years to arrive. Of announced but not-yet-started capacity, respondents generally expect 20%-50% will never be built.

cross_industry.detail: ST's fourth round (Nov 4 letter, circulating online, not confirmed on its official site), NXP's third round (Nov 2 letter) and Renesas's adjustment took effect the same day, with magnitudes and part numbers undisclosed officially. About 80% of NXP products now have lead times over 16 weeks (25% a year ago); ST MCUs are about 54 weeks and some Infineon 32-bit MCU parts reach 97 weeks.

The China Passenger Car Association forecast on Nov 19 that November NEV retail sales will be about 1.15 million units with penetration of about 70.6%, breaking 70% for the first time — but actual retail sales for Nov 1-15 were 447,000 units (-13% year on year), with the rising share mainly reflecting shrinking gasoline-car sales. NEVs keep squeezing IGBT, automotive-grade MLCC and copper capacity.

Samsung and Xiaomi have raised prices on 41 models in India since Nov 16 by INR 1,000-4,000, with handset makers' memory costs up about 350% over the year. Global smartphone shipments fell 22% year on year in Q3 to 255.3 million units.
cross_industry.source: MEA Tech Watch, Nov 17, 2026; Counterpoint via CellularHeros, Nov 21, 2026

cross_industry.detail: TI's Sep 1 price-adjustment letter and ADI precision analog parts with lead times of 60-70 weeks; general-server PMIC lead times have stretched from 21-26 weeks to 35-40 weeks, and 8-inch wafer utilization is 88% and heading toward 90%.

Polysilicon spot prices averaged $5.79/kg (flat for the week of Nov 18), the SMM index at CNY 41.09/kg weakened during the week, and some producers have delayed December maintenance, tilting the outlook downward. Inventory drawdown is pressing prices down, with no upward cost pass-through to HVAC.

supplier_updates.detail: SHFE copper main contract fell 5.07% on Nov 19 to CNY 94,720/t and another 3.35% on Nov 20 to CNY 92,400/t. LME copper was quoted at $12,022.45/t on Nov 20 (-4.02%, Mysteel basis). SHFE inventories stand at 27,640 tons (the lowest since December 2023), and China's refined-copper import premium is at a record $360/t (Mysteel, Nov 19-20; BigGo Finance, Nov 21).

The SHFE main aluminum contract closed Nov 20 at CNY 21,535/t (+0.96%), East China aluminum ingot at CNY 22,340/t (+CNY 60), and SHFE aluminum warehouse warrants fell by 3,294 tons to 32,470 tons. Electrolytic aluminum inventories keep drawing down (Mysteel, Nov 20).

US plate lead times have stretched to the end of January 2027, with some mills only having availability from mid-to-late February. Dimensional Metals announced on Nov 6 that steel plate/coil prices rise about 4%-5% from Nov 23 (orders placed before the Nov 20 close and shipped by Dec 4 still get the old price). Nucor hot-rolled coil was quoted at $1,295/t on Nov 9 (Steel Market Update, Nov 12; Dimensional Metals, Nov 6).
Praseodymium-neodymium oxide holds in the CNY 715,000-725,500/t range, and dysprosium oxide is firm at CNY 1,525,000-1,535,000/t (Hesheng Magnetic Mining, Nov 17; Mysteel, Nov 20).

R32 East China steady at CNY 63,500-64,500/t; R410A at CNY 57,000-59,500/t (the verified Nov 13 range; the Nov 13-19 weekly review confirmed firm, flat quotes). Q4 contract reference prices: R32 CNY 65,600/t, R410A CNY 60,500/t. No new price notices from Juhua / Dongyue / Sanmei / Yonghe in the window (OpenThermalAI Week 46 briefing, citing Mysteel / OilChem; Mysteel refrigerant weekly review, Nov 13-19).

Samsung Electro-Mechanics' Q4 consumer X5R quotes are up 25%-30% and AI-grade X6S up 10%-20% (TrendForce estimate). Resistor lead times stay tight: Viking precision thin-film and standard thick-film resistors average 25 weeks (15 weeks in May), with some orders already scheduled into H2 2027. Automotive-grade resistors are 20-30 weeks. No new Q4 price-hike letters seen as of Nov 8 (MoneyToday, Nov 18; AutoDCSTech, Oct 25 / Nov 2 update).

Shengyi's November price increases have landed (M6 and below laminates +15%, prepreg PP +25%), and Kingboard has raised prices for the eighth time this year. High-performance CCL procurement runs 24-32 weeks, with 106/1080/2116 glass-fiber cloth in short supply and several suppliers on allocation (Pengcheng Business News citing China Securities Journal, Nov 10; VersaLogic, Nov 4).

TrendForce: Q4 PC DRAM contract prices up 13%-18% quarter on quarter, enterprise SSDs up 15%-20%. SanDisk raised November NAND contract prices by about 50% (its third increase this year), and module makers have suspended quoting and deliveries. Spot prices diverge: 512Gb TLC wafer spot is about $15, down about 20% in two weeks (TrendForce via CtrlTechDaily; Xintong News, Nov 11).

ST's fourth-round price-hike rumor (effective Jan 1, 2027; no official letter seen). Infineon and Megmeet are jointly developing an 800 VDC data-center power architecture (CoolSiC MOSFET G2), announced Nov 19. onsemi's fourth-generation EliteSiC M4 platform launched (power density +30%, conduction losses -35%). Siemens' Nov 1 price adjustment has taken effect, with no new developments in this window. Schneider / ABB / Zhengtai / Delixi have issued no new letters (finanzen.at, Nov 19; Silicon Feeds, Nov 9-15 weekly).
No new price-hike letters or adjustment notices from Schneider, ABB, Siemens, Zhengtai or Delixi in the window; nothing abnormal found.

LATO interviews: grid connection is the most-cited cause of data-center delays, and large transformers take more than two years to arrive. Medium-voltage switchgear runs 52-80 weeks, pad-mount transformers 40-65 weeks, substation transformers 90-160 weeks, and large power transformers 160-210 weeks (LATO, around Nov 19).

While LME copper fell, the Shanghai Yangshan copper import premium rose to about $240/t in early November, in record territory, and SHFE copper inventories were 33,848 tons on Nov 6 (a three-year low) — busbar landed costs did not fall with LME (SYBusbar, November).

Formosa's Point Comfort, Texas plant declared force majeure on some polyethylene grades on Oct 29 after an Oct 28 fire. North American PE producers are signaling November price increases of 5-7 US cents/lb (PlasInsight, Nov 18).

Frick / Sabroe / YORK are switching SAP systems: Nov 30 at 13:00 EST is the last order intake before the switch; order entry, shipping and fulfillment fully suspended Dec 1-6, resuming Dec 7. Thanksgiving on Nov 26 further compresses the window (Keep Supply dealer notice, Nov 19).

This round (batch 7) covered 11 subcategories, with 3 hits worth carrying in (diverging busbar landed costs, persistently tight resistor lead times, and plate/profile price hikes with longer lead times); the other 8 items showed no anomalies.

No anomalies across the five compressor types (centrifugal / reciprocating / rotary / scroll / screw): Highly, GMCC and Lingda had no price or lead-time news in the window. Danfoss showcased cold-source, CDU, secondary-side fluid-network and rack-connection liquid-cooling solutions at CDCC on Nov 20.
No anomalies found in refrigerant oil checks.
No anomalies found for variable-frequency drives: no new price-adjustment or lead-time news in the window.
No anomalies found for valves and heat exchangers.
